llm_response.reason: The website displays classic signs of a scam: it claims users can collect valuable in-game rewards (M416 - Glacier, X-Suit, etc.) by entering personal details and logging into their Facebook accounts. It employs psychological urgency with a countdown timer, lacks company and contact information, and mimics the style of a legitimate PUBG event without verification. There are no privacy notices, legitimate business contact points, or real company info, and no hyperlinks function as expected—all aligning with Fake Online Shopping and phishing tactics.
